en.board_description: Interactive Violin Fingerboard Tool: Visualize accurate semitone positions, note names, frequencies, & string length %. Customize pitch standard (A=440/442Hz), and switch between Just Intonation or Equal Temperament for precise fingering.
en.board_pref_runing_just_intonation: Use Just Intonation (tuning with perfect fifths at a 3:2 frequency ratio)
en.board_seo_faq_a1: Yes, this violin fingerboard chart is completely free with no registration required.
en.board_seo_faq_a2: Yes, the tool is fully responsive and works on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers.
en.board_seo_faq_a3: Equal Temperament divides the octave into 12 equal parts, making all keys sound equally in tune. Just Intonation uses pure mathematical ratios between notes, producing more resonant intervals but only in certain keys.
en.board_seo_faq_q1: Is this tool free to use?
en.board_seo_faq_q2: Can I use this on my phone?
en.board_seo_faq_q3: What is the difference between Equal Temperament and Just Intonation?
en.board_seo_features_1: Interactive fingerboard with all four strings (G, D, A, E) and accurate semitone positions
en.board_seo_features_2: Multiple display modes: pitch names, solfège, frequencies, octave numbers, string length %, and semitone index
en.board_seo_features_3: Customizable pitch standard (A=440Hz, 442Hz, or any value)
en.board_seo_features_4: Switch between Equal Temperament and Just Intonation tuning systems
en.board_seo_features_5: Scale and mode highlighting for major and minor keys
en.board_seo_features_6: Built-in sound playback — hear each note when you tap a finger position
en.board_seo_features_7: Adjustable string length and number of semitones per string
en.board_seo_h1: Violin Fingerboard Chart — Interactive Finger Position Tool
en.board_seo_howto_1: Tap any position on the fingerboard to see and hear the note
en.board_seo_howto_2: Use the Display panel to choose which information to show (pitch, solfège, frequency, etc.)
en.board_seo_howto_3: Adjust the pitch standard in the String panel (default A=440Hz)
en.board_seo_howto_4: Select a key/mode to highlight scale notes on the fingerboard
en.board_seo_howto_5: Toggle Just Intonation for pure fifth tuning (3:2 frequency ratio)
en.board_seo_intro_p: This is a free, interactive violin fingerboard chart that helps violinists visualize every note position on the fingerboard. Whether you are a beginner learning finger placement or an advanced player exploring intonation systems, this tool provides accurate semitone positions, note names, solfège syllables, frequencies, and string length percentages — all in one place.
en.board_seo_tuning_p1: The violin has four strings tuned in perfect fifths: G3, D4, A4, and E5. The standard tuning reference is A4=440Hz, though many orchestras tune to A4=442Hz or higher.
en.board_seo_tuning_p2: This tool supports two tuning systems. Equal Temperament divides the octave into 12 equal semitones, which is the standard system used in most modern music. Just Intonation tunes intervals using pure frequency ratios (such as 3:2 for a perfect fifth), producing purer harmonics but limiting key modulation.
